# Demographics

This folder contains demographic variables used as metrics for healthcare analysis and quality assessment within the corpus. It currently holds a single entity page for patient age ("alder"), which is tracked in the Acute Surgery Database (AKDB). The page details how age is analyzed and compared across Denmark's five regions, documenting specific claims that there is no significant difference in the age of operated patients between these regions.

## Pages

- [[alder]] — Documents patient age as a demographic variable in acute surgery, including regional comparisons across Denmark's five regions showing no significant age differences among operated patients.
